meta.title: Nowon Lee — Frontend Engineer
meta.description: Technical profile of frontend engineer Nowon Lee, focused on tracing service issues, improving data flow and asynchronous state, and verifying production behavior

identity.name: Nowon Lee
identity.lead: I trace service issues to their causes, improve data flow and asynchronous state, and verify behavior after deployment.
identity.supporting: I have solved problems involving real-time data, long-running tasks, operational dashboards, and service quality in TypeScript and React web services.

experience.title: Experience
experience.introduction: The focus is on engineering decisions and verified changes rather than job descriptions.

companies.summary: I worked on real-time data processing, long-running asynchronous tasks, operational dashboards, and quality assurance for public-sector web service projects.

contributions.title: Data & Monitoring
contributions.summary: I improved the dashboard's query and transformation structure and corrected metrics that did not match the actual API responses.
contributions.detail: Each update requests only the interval after the previous request time.

contributions.title: Async State & Realtime
contributions.summary: I changed status tracking for five-to-ten-minute document generation tasks from continuous polling to event-triggered server checks.
contributions.detail: The event does not determine completion; the server response remains the source for UI state.

contributions.title: Browser Runtime & Realtime Data
contributions.summary: I eliminated three-to-four-second UI freezes during requests and transformations of responses around 5 MB.
contributions.detail: API requests and response transformations run in a SharedWorker so the main thread can focus on rendering.

contributions.title: Reliability & Delivery
contributions.summary: I built an E2E suite that repeatedly exercises user journeys before deployment and uncovered an authentication-state defect.
contributions.detail: The suite reproduces the sequence where browser credentials remain after the server session expires.

companies.summary: I traced errors and performance regressions in React and TypeScript services and improved data updates, loading performance, and real-time connections.

contributions.title: State Consistency
contributions.summary: I applied optimistic updates alongside periodic refetching to reduce duplicate requests and resolve discrepancies between the UI and server values.
contributions.detail: I verified the UI state when the refresh interval overlaps with a user change.
contributions.evidence: One rule for user changes and server refreshes

contributions.title: Loading & Realtime
contributions.summary: I configured Vite and React lazy loading and identified the cause of intermittent WebSocket disconnections.
contributions.detail: I documented the loading improvements so they could be applied to other frontend projects.
contributions.evidence: Reusable loading setup and restored real-time updates

openSource.title: Open Source
openSource.introduction: Changes merged into external projects and included in official releases.

contributions.summary: Fixed optional URL parameters incorrectly matching paths that lacked a `/` separator.
contributions.verification: Added regression coverage while preserving existing dot-suffix behavior.

contributions.summary: Fixed an editor defect that prevented Delete or Backspace from removing the final character before an inline image.
contributions.verification: Verified deletion inside and outside tables while preserving regular text deletion.

independentWork.title: Independent Work
independentWork.introduction: Work I defined and implemented outside company projects.

items.title: AI Agent Workflow
items.summary: I designed repository rules and skills to keep requirements, research, decisions, and implementation distinct, including a Korean wording check before text is stored. I have applied the workflow across multiple repositories.

items.title: Offline Translation Web App
items.summary: After users save the required language models, the browser can translate between Korean and English or Korean and Japanese without a network connection. I implemented the workflow with browser caching, Web Workers, and IndexedDB, and automated deployment with GitHub Actions.

items.detail: Human Resources Development Service of Korea
